correctness.rationale: At round one every external neighbor acquires each pathogen independently by pairwise exposure; the source-carriage indicators are independent Bernoulli(s). The round-two conditional acquisition averages are exactly U and V, giving the stated marginal M and joint J and their covariance factorization. Positivity and finite hazard prove the unique interior threshold. The overlap example and 97 exact-rational full-transition cases independently test the algebra; finite checks are not used as proof.

value.rationale: A complete sharp association-sign classification for a naturally motivated two-step outbreak experiment shows that facilitative susceptibility can yield negative measured co-carriage and competition can yield positive measured co-carriage under synchronous non-reinfection. It holds for arbitrary finite hypergraphs, including overlap reinforcement, and clarifies a real identifiability confound not answered by a one-step hazard or qualitative prevalence trend. The all-graph degree-only corollary adds structural information.
